title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: In Honduras, ICSP advanced climate‑resilient local economic systems through Blue Economy, Green Economy and Urban Resilience initiatives, with most participants reporting increased income and improved household stability. Support to producers, fishers and small businesses strengthened economic resilience, while expanded access to financial services, market‑oriented skills and climate‑smart practices boosted productivity and promoted responsible resource management. Lagoon rehabilitation and sustainable fishing contributed to more reliable food access for vulnerable households. Preparedness for food and nutrition‑related hazards improved through multi‑hazard early‑warning systems and community response structures, enabling earlier protective action across coastal and inland food systems.. Due to increasing climate‑driven threats to agriculture, fisheries and small enterprises in Honduras, ICSP prioritises climate‑resilient local economic systems, through Blue and Green Economy initiatives, early‑warning integration and support to producers and small businesses, to help households sustain livelihoods and adapt to increasingly frequent environmental shocks.
